# Gemma-26B, thinking on against thinking off (paired trial keys)

*Generated by `tools/reanalysis/gemma_think.py`; do not edit, rerun the script.* Self-check: the 4 figures of the 2026-11-09 CHANGELOG entry reproduce (sweep5v2-live: 4,560 of 4,560 no-tools think-on responses open a thought channel; no-tools validate_plan cut by the budget 9 → 2,690 of 3,000; plain validate_plan without a call 2,981, of which 2,025 cut inside the thought channel).

Success = the stored grade (`success`): the online grade unaided, tool-verified on the tools cell. Cut = `done_reason == "length"`. Thought = the response opens `<|channel>thought` or a bare `thought` line (the leaked empty marker `<|channel>thought\n<channel|>` does not count). No call, cut in thought = rows without a call whose answer ran out before `<channel|>`.
